versions.changelog:
Initial release of the mail-messenger skill:

- Supports sending emails via SMTP for major providers (Gmail, Outlook, QQ, 163, enterprise mail)
- Allows retrieval of emails using IMAP with flexible filtering
- Supports common message notification methods (Webhook, WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk bots)
- Strong focus on security: credentials must use environment variables or injected parameters, never hard-coded
- Includes workflow guides, quick reference for SMTP setups, and checklist for safe email sending
- Built-in "self-improve" learning scripts for reliability tracking and usage optimization
